note: Service request types for the journeys that must never sell. These are DATA: adding a type here produces a working terminal with no code change, exactly as adding a product to the catalogue does. Fields use the same ApplicationField shape the product derivation produces, so the page, the prompt and the pre-fill do not need to know which family they are looking at.

serviceRequests.title: Freeze a card
serviceRequests.summary: Stop further spending on a card while we work out what happened.
serviceRequests.recordedOutcome: A freeze instruction was recorded against {subject} and a case was raised for a relationship manager to pick up.
neverClaim: that the card has actually been blocked
that any transaction has been reversed
that a card network or issuer has been contacted

fields.label: Which card
fields.prompt: Which card did the contact refer to?

fields.label: A code, PIN or password was shared
fields.prompt: Was a one-time code, PIN, CVV or password shared with them?

fields.label: Money has already moved
fields.prompt: Has any money already left the account?

fields.label: A link was opened or an app installed
fields.prompt: Was a link opened, or anything installed on your phone?

serviceRequests.title: Raise a fraud report
serviceRequests.summary: Put the suspicious contact on record so it can be investigated and others can be warned.
serviceRequests.recordedOutcome: A fraud report was recorded for {subject}, with everything this conversation established attached to it.
neverClaim: that law enforcement or a regulator has been notified
that any money will be returned
that the sender has been identified or blocked

fields.label: How they made contact
fields.prompt: How did they get in touch?

fields.label: What they asked for
fields.prompt: What did they ask you to do or share?

fields.label: Money has already moved
fields.prompt: Has any money already left the account?

evidence.label: The message or screenshot
evidence.requirement: A screenshot or forward of the message, if you still have it. Not required to raise the report.

serviceRequests.title: Raise a dispute
serviceRequests.summary: Put a disputed payment on record with the evidence already gathered, and track it to an outcome.
serviceRequests.recordedOutcome: A dispute record was created for {subject}, with the evidence timeline from this conversation attached.
neverClaim: that a chargeback has been raised with a card network
that the merchant has been contacted
that a refund has been issued or is guaranteed
that any money has been credited back

fields.label: What went wrong
fields.prompt: What is the problem with this payment?

fields.label: What the merchant promised
fields.prompt: What did the merchant actually commit to, and when?

fields.label: Something has already been credited back
fields.prompt: Has any part of it already come back to you?

evidence.label: Correspondence with the merchant
evidence.requirement: The order confirmation, refund receipt or chat with the merchant, if you have it.

serviceRequests.title: Request a pre-authorisation check
serviceRequests.summary: Ask the insurer to confirm, before treatment, which lines on an estimate are covered.
serviceRequests.recordedOutcome: A pre-authorisation request was recorded against {subject}. It records the lines you asked about so a relationship manager can take it to the insurer.
neverClaim: that the insurer has approved or declined anything
that any amount is covered or will be paid
that a hospital or insurer has been contacted

fields.label: The policy
fields.prompt: Which policy should this be checked against?

fields.label: The lines you want checked
fields.prompt: Which specific line items on the estimate are unclear?

fields.label: Treatment is imminent
fields.prompt: Is the treatment booked or about to happen?

evidence.label: The hospital estimate
evidence.requirement: The estimate document itself, so the specific line items can be quoted to the insurer.
